tagline: Leading European healthcare REIT creating value through capital recycling
hero_kpi_rationale: The healthcare portfolio represents 77% of total assets, becoming the primary growth driver and differentiating strategy for Cofinimmo in Europe, gradually replacing offices.
company_description: Cofinimmo is a listed European REIT specialized in healthcare real estate (77% of portfolio), with complementary activities in offices and distribution networks. Its positioning is based on in-house asset management and an integrated sustainability strategy.

kpis.name: Healthcare Portfolio Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of portfolio value invested in healthcare real estate.
kpis.description: The company has pivoted toward healthcare since 2018, with net investments of €4.6 Bn in this segment.
kpis.signal: Successful strategic transition to healthcare in Europe.

kpis.name: Net Result from Recurring Activities
kpis.explanation: Core earnings of the company, equivalent to EPRA earnings.
kpis.description: Earnings growth despite divestments, supported by healthcare leasing.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.description: High occupancy rate across the entire portfolio, especially in healthcare.

kpis.name: Weighted Lease Term
kpis.explanation: Average remaining duration of lease contracts.
kpis.description: Long leases, often inflation-indexed, ensuring income visibility.
kpis.signal: Long-term income visibility with inflation-linked agreements.

kpis.name: Debt to Assets Ratio
kpis.explanation: Leverage level relative to asset value.
kpis.description: Low ratio enabling financing of new investments.
kpis.signal: Solid financial structure with low leverage.

kpis.name: Cost of Debt
kpis.explanation: Average interest rate paid on debt.
kpis.description: Low-cost debt in a high interest rate environment.
kpis.signal: Very low borrowing cost despite elevated rate environment.

kpis.name: 2025 Investment Budget
kpis.description: €170 M investment budget in 2025, primarily in healthcare.
kpis.signal: Continued commitment to healthcare real estate expansion.

kpis.name: 2025 Dividend Outlook
kpis.description: Dividend adjusted to €5.20 in 2025 to support future growth.
kpis.signal: Dividend adjustment supporting medium-term growth strategy.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total annual dividend paid per share over the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid + share buybacks.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends and buybacks (2021-2025) in billions EUR. Source: yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income redistributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Financial difficulties of healthcare operators
risks.summary: Healthcare operators have faced financial difficulties since late 2025. Cofinimmo must manage contractual rent arrears without accounting provisions at this stage, threatening its rental income.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified early in the report (pages 264-269) with moderate language ('review the situation') but material impact: certain contractual rents unpaid in 2026. Trend: new/increasing (reported late 2025-early 2026). Credit category: high weight for healthcare real estate REIT (€4.7 Bn healthcare portfolio).

risks.title: Healthcare portfolio concentration
risks.summary: Cofinimmo's portfolio is highly concentrated in healthcare real estate (77% of total value). This sector dependency amplifies exposure to healthcare sector challenges.
risks.score_rationale: Major structural position: €4.7 Bn out of €6.1 Bn total (77% of portfolio) in healthcare real estate. Strong implicit language (mission centered on 'care'). Trend: stable but exacerbated by healthcare crisis. Credit category: existential sector concentration risk for REIT.

risks.title: Decline in fair value of real estate assets
risks.summary: The fair value of investment properties decreased by €7.1 million in Q1 2026, compared to an increase of €5.6 million the previous year. This deterioration reduces net asset value.
risks.score_rationale: Change in fair value of -€7.1 Bn as of March 31, 2026 vs +€5.6 Bn as of March 31, 2025 (reversal of €12.7 Bn). Mid-report position (financial results). Factual language but material impact on NAV. Trend: increasing (significant deterioration N-1). Capital category: high weight for REIT.

risks.title: Increase in property management expenses
risks.summary: Property management costs increased by 69% between 2025 and 2026, rising from €8.7 to €14.7 million. This rise compresses operating margins.
risks.score_rationale: Property management expenses increased from €8.7 Bn to €14.7 Bn (+69% N-1). Mid-report position (operational detail). Factual language. Trend: increasing. Industrial category: moderate weight but signal of operational inflation.

risks.title: Geographic exposure across multiple European countries
risks.summary: Cofinimmo is exposed to varied geopolitical and regulatory risks across 9 European countries. Local political tensions or changes could affect its operations and revenues.
risks.score_rationale: Portfolio spread across 9 countries (Belgium, France, Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Finland, Ireland, Italy, UK). End of report position (description). Neutral language. Trend: stable. Geopolitical category: moderate weight (diversification also protective).

ai_positioning.summary: Cofinimmo does not mention any strategy or initiatives related to artificial intelligence in recent documents. The company focuses on traditional real estate management and sustainability.
evidence: No mention of AI in 2024 roadshow presentation
No references to predictive analytics or AI-based automation tools
Priority given to sustainability and asset management
